task: Copy blaze's pinned LLVM from one ix VM to another
do: ix shell <from> -- bash -c 'cd /root/.blaze/native && tar -cf - sha256-<hash> | zstd -9 -T8 -q' | ix shell <to> -- bash -c 'mkdir -p /root/.blaze/native && cd /root/.blaze/native && zstd -d -q | tar -xf -'
why: Compressed in the pipe the 356 MB tree moved in under two minutes; uncompressed it took about 20 (rows records-6, edit2-3).
